messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Bupropion is an antidepressant medication used to treat depression and seasonal affective disorder. It also supports smoking cessation and weight management. Bupropion is the active ingredient in Wellbutrin and Zyban, Auvelity contains bupropion and dextromethorphan, and Contrave contains bupropion and naltrexone. Bupropion improves mood regulation and nicotine cravings and, when combined with naltrexone, helps reduce food intake.
Bupropion is thought to work by changing levels of certain chemicals in the brain, including noradrenaline and dopamine.
Bupropion first became an FDA-approved medicine on 30 December 1985.

In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'reduces risk of': The subject drug is used to prevent or lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'lowers level of': The subject drug decreases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
